escena: SCENE (staged, editorial high-impact studio photograph, Efeonce creative studio at night): a Chilean creative director in her late twenties, curly dark hair loose, wearing the NAVY EFEONCE HOODIE, has just thrown a big handful of printed color swatch cards and paper cutouts straight up into the air and is caught laughing, face tilted up, arms still open, in the exact instant they explode around her. Hundreds of cards and cutouts frozen mid-air by a high-speed flash, in saturated vivid orange, hot magenta, deep azure-blue (#0375DB) and teal, some sharp, some motion-blurred at the edges, filling the upper two thirds of the frame. A strong warm orange light from behind and above rims her curls and the flying cards; a cool magenta gel fill from the left paints her cheek; thin haze catches the colored beams. Deep dark studio background so the colors burst. Framed from the waist up, centered. 35mm f/2.8, 1/8000 s, punchy editorial color, rich contrast, no readable text on any card.

lecho.objeto: the dark edge of a worktable at the bottom of the frame, dissolved into blur
